"The following procedure is used for time series data to compute forecast accuracy: For each time point k+i, where i = 1, 2, ..., T-k and T is the total number of observations, use observations at times 1, 2, ..., k+i-1 to estimate the forecasting model. Compute the error on the forecast for k+i. Repeat the above step for i = 2,...,T-k. Compute the forecast accuracy based on the errors obtained. Then, use the final estimated model to compute the forecast for the test observation. Repeat the above step for i = 1,2,..., N where N is the total number of observations in the test set. Compute the forecast accuracy measures based on the errors obtained. This makes efficient use of the available data, as only one observation is omitted at each step."

"Juan Rulfo is a renowned Mexican writer and photographer. His photography has been featured in two books: "Juan Rulfo: Mexico, 1950-1990 Photography" and "Juan Rulfo Fotógrafo, 2001". The Spanish language edition of his photographs was published in 2001 with essays by the same authors as the volume above, but written in Spanish. Rulfo's photography provides a unique perspective on Mexico, capturing the beauty and complexity of the country and its people.

"The story of Abraham and Isaac in Genesis 22 has been interpreted as a rite of passage, complete with a mock sacrifice. This interpretation suggests that the story reflects the liturgy of a religious ritual that was commonly found in early and preliterate societies. The prohibition against human sacrifices, which was a common practice at the time, adds to the significance of this story as a departure from the norm."
